title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text: 1. Urges Member States to prioritise the promotion and protection of democracy and human rights within the EU; emphasises that the EU does not have a mandate to act as a human rights watchdog and often employs human rights as a pretext for interference in the internal affairs of non-EU countries; emphasises that the rights of Europeans should be prioritised, particularly in the light of the many challenges our continent currently faces, such as the rise in insecurity and Islamism;
